# v0.12.0-rc17 — P5R Mementos Requests

This candidate contains the P5R Mementos Requests tracking and Calendar return-state fixes merged after rc16.

## Highlights

- Replaces the P5R Answers tab with a dedicated **Mementos Requests** tracker; class and exam answers remain available in the daily walkthrough.
- Adds all **33 Persona 5 Royal Mementos Requests**.
- Auto-completes each request only when its exact completion task is checked, avoiding false completion from related setup tasks.
- Preserves the Calendar's browsed month after opening a Day page and returning to Calendar.
- Adds schema, pack-loading, navigation, progress, content-audit, lint, and Calendar regression coverage for the new behavior.

## Validation carried into this candidate

- All 33 request completion selectors resolve to exactly one walkthrough step.
- Existing walkthrough task indexes remain unchanged.
- Candidate CI runs the Android build, JVM/unit tests, and content-pack validation before publication.
